      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number

            normalized by removing every non-digit character and must contain
            exactly 10 digits after stripping.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'

          title: Email address
          description: >-

## Summary

The spec required that when no registration date is supplied on owner creation, the server defaults it to the current date, and `registrationDate` is returned in ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` format (while a supplied date is preserved).

Changes made:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `registrationDate` property (`type: string`, `format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. Since `Owner` is `allOf` OwnerFields, this generates the field on both `OwnerFieldsDto` (input) and `OwnerDto` (output) as a `LocalDate`, which Jackson serializes as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

2. **`Owner.java`** — Added a persistent `LocalDate registrationDate` field mapped to a `registration_date` column, with getter/setter.

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — Added a `defaultRegistrationDate(...)` step that sets `registrationDate` to `LocalDate.now()` only when the caller omitted it; a supplied value passes through unchanged.

4. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — Added a `registration_date DATE` column to the `owners` table. The tests run against the hsqldb schema (`ddl-auto=none`), so this column was required; the others are updated for consistency.

The MapStruct `OwnerMapper` picks up the same-named `registrationDate` automatically in both directions, so no mapper change was needed.

Test results: `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — both `coreDefaultsToToday` and `functionalityKeepsSuppliedDate` pass, and the full suite is **BUILD SUCCESS**.
